description: This file defines a report for project summaries in a Frappe/ERPNext application, including functions to fetch project data, generate chart data, and create a report summary.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate project summary report data, including columns, project data, chart, and summary.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the project summary report.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart data (bar chart) for project tasks, including overdue, completed, and total tasks.

methods.name: get_report_summary
methods.description: Calculates summary metrics such as average completion, total tasks, completed tasks, and overdue tasks.
